onboardingBody1: Track your meals and understand their nutritional value. Real-time scanning visualizes caloric density, macro splits, and vital bio-availability in under 800 milliseconds.
onboardingBody2: Get personalized nutritional insights and healthier alternatives. The engine detects metabolic inflammatory triggers and formulates clean bio-compatible food swaps.
onboardingBody3: Track your progress and make better decisions every day. Micro-streaks, continuous hydration metrics, and biomarker calibration solidify sustainable vitality without dietary deprivation.
onboardingBullet1aSubtitle: Computes portion mass and calories directly from photographic depth maps.
onboardingBullet1bSubtitle: Instant visualization of protein, slow carbs, healthy omega fats, and fibers.
onboardingBullet2aSubtitle: Identifies refined sugars, seed oils, and sodium spikes before consumption.
onboardingBullet2bSubtitle: Recommends nutrient-dense alternatives that maintain your culinary satisfaction.
onboardingBullet3aSubtitle: Positive neurological anchoring converts choices into permanent routines.
onboardingBullet3bSubtitle: Exportable PDF logs directly formatted for your consulting clinical physician.
onboardingDisclaimer: NutriVision provides estimated dietary insights. Not intended for clinical or medical diagnosis.
swapReasoning: Fermentation degrades phytates, stabilizing glucose absorption by 42 minutes and supporting a diverse gut microbiome.
